 pattern = re.compile(r'(breakfast|breakfast\s+menu|breakfast\s+service)', re.IGNORECASE)

 # Iterate through each row and check if the sponsor name matches the pattern
 for row in range(1, 30):
   value = df.loc[row, 'sponsor']

   # If the sponsor name matches the pattern, add 'Breakfast Available' to the Cleaned Code column
   if pattern.search(value):
     df.loc[row, 'Cleaned Code'] = 'Breakfast Available'

 # Print the updated DataFrame for verification
 print(df)
return value
